children.name: Hoilungia
children.description: A placozoan genus discovered in 2018 in Hong Kong marine waters. Represents a distinct lineage basal within the phylum.

children.name: Hoilungia hongkongensis
children.description: Described in 2018 from Hong Kong waters. Genetic analysis showed it represents a separate lineage distinct from Trichoplax, leading to the recognition of multiple placozoan classes.
